rows.section_title: Software Assurance and Software Independent Verification & Validation
rows.requirement_text: For projects reaching Key Decision Point A, the program manager shall ensure that software IV&V is performed on the following categories of projects: a. Category 1 projects as defined in NPR 7120.5. b. Category 2 projects as defined in NPR 7120.5 that have Class A or Class B payload risk classification per NPR 8705.4. c. Projects selected explicitly by the NASA Chief, Safety and Mission Assurance to have software IV&V.
rows.implementation: Intent preserved by independent reviewer agents (charter section 2). Independent concurrence record in docs/reviews/SRR/ is Planned for SRR.
rows.tailoring_rationale: IV&V is invoked for NPR 7120.5 Category 1 and 2 projects; cwht is neither.
rows.residual_risk: Residual risk: defects an IV&V organization would find escape; mitigated by author, reviewer and test-author independence.
